referenceFunction.generalComment: The functional unit represents 1 m2 of a 6-layer FR-4 PWB, surface finished (mixture of Pb-containing and Pb-free methods), with soldermask, for surface mount applications, without mounted components. It is designed to be used in ICT applications.; UUID: 936cf293-e879-357b-a1ac-9ba3c4d3f741
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module represents a 0:100 mixture of the datasets “printed wiring board, surface mount, Pb-containing surface, at plant” and “printed wiring board, surface mount, Pb-free surface, at plant”. It is assumed that after 2023 updates, no lead containing electronics are used in the market.
